nodes.name: .npmrc
nodes.summary: npm configuration enabling legacy-peer-deps resolution so the frontend's dependency tree installs without peer-dependency conflicts.

nodes.name: nginx.conf
nodes.summary: Nginx server config for the production frontend image: serves the built static SPA on port 80 and falls back to index.html for client-side routing.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet defining the Tailwind/shadcn design tokens (light and dark color variables, radius, chart and sidebar colors) applied across the whole frontend.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses OKLCH color space CSS custom properties and Tailwind's @custom-variant for dark-mode targeting.

nodes.name: schema.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated TypeScript type definitions (via openapi-typescript) mirroring the backend's OpenAPI spec, covering paths and operations such as auth login/refresh/logout.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-generated file with a 'do not edit directly' header; regenerated from the API's OpenAPI document.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: One-line barrel re-exporting the shared `cn` class-name utility for use throughout the frontend's UI components.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Frontend entry point that mounts the React app, wiring up TanStack Query and the generated TanStack Router route tree.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration wiring the TanStack Router plugin, React plugin, and Tailwind CSS plugin, plus a `@` src path alias and Vitest jsdom test setup.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Explains how to bring up the full stack (frontend, backend, PostgreSQL) via docker-compose using prebuilt GHCR images, including ports, seeded accounts, and teardown commands.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose stack that orchestrates prebuilt postgres, api, and web images (published to GHCR by CI) with health-checked startup ordering and a durable Postgres volume.

nodes.name: postgres
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL 17 database service with a named volume for durable storage and a healthcheck used to gate startup of dependent services.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Backend API service running the ghcr.io excel-management-api image, configured to connect to the postgres service and waiting for it to report healthy before starting.

nodes.name: web
nodes.summary: Frontend service running the nginx-served static build image, published on port 5173 and depending on the api service.

nodes.name: Exam Data.xlsx
nodes.summary: Sample Excel workbook provided as project requirements input, likely used as sample/reference data for the employee Excel import/export feature.

nodes.name: Exercise Before Interview.docx
nodes.summary: Word document containing the original pre-interview coding exercise instructions that this excel-management project was built to satisfy.
